Name: Weaponpack - Dark Cloud 2 Spheda Clubs
Author: GallumX
Description:
Not gonna spend too much time on a description here, the mod is pretty self-explanatory. I adapted the DC2 sprites to be used in stardew.

Every weapon I added can be found on[url=https://darkcloud.fandom.com/wiki/Maximilian's_melee_weapons?so=search] [/url][url=https://darkcloud.fandom.com/wiki/Maximilian's_melee_weapons?so=search]this [/url]page, save for a bonus sword that was cut from the game, the macho sword. Also [url=https://imgur.com/a/tHoOpS2]here [/url]are screenshots of the stats of each weapon.

This is a very simple mod that does require Jason Assets and SMAPI to work. A lot of the design decisions when it comes to stats were admittedly quite arbitrary. However, every weapon uses the min and max attack stats from DC2, which panned out pretty well as far as balancing goes, and also is quite novel if you ask me.

You install this just like any other stardew mod. I hope you enjoy it, and I am absolutely open to and encouraging of suggestions when it comes to stats on each weapon. I'm not perfect, and this mod can certainly stand to be improved so feel more than welcome to suggest edits if you think a weapon is OP, or UP for what it is.


As a [i]huge [/i]diehard fan of DC2, I want to also encourage everyone to play it if you have not already.
